name: Tau hu nong
summary: Tàu hũ nóng is hot, soft tofu, mildly rich and lightly fragrant. Eat it with sweet-sour fish sauce or soy sauce.
origin: Vung Tau, on Thùy Vân and Hoàng Hoa Thám.
taste: The tofu is mildly rich and lightly fragrant.
howToEat: Eat it hot as a snack or a first plate, with sweet-sour fish sauce or soy sauce.
where: Thùy Vân and Hoàng Hoa Thám.
seoTitle: Tau hu nong — hot tofu in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Hot soft tofu on Thùy Vân and Hoàng Hoa Thám, mildly rich and lightly fragrant, with sweet-sour fish sauce or soy sauce.
